description: Render diagram flows as a GIF or MP4 artifact. Uses deterministic frame captures through Chrome plus ffmpeg; requires an `output` path because video payloads are too large for MCP text.

backgroundColor.description: CSS background color (defaults to the theme canvas)

duration.description: Seconds to render (default: one full flow cycle)

format.description: Output format; inferred from `output` extension when omitted

fps.description: Frames per second (default: 12 for GIF, 30 for MP4)

includeGrid.description: Render the diagram grid (default: branded themes on, others off)

mode.description: Color mode; defaults to the theme default

output.description: Destination file path for the GIF or MP4

padding.description: Padding around the export bounds in px (default: 20)

theme.description: Arc theme id: default, warm, cool, mono, engineering, workbench, tactical, command, spacex, claude, codex, or inherit

name: render_animation
